request.text: In forty-five minutes, check in and ask whether I've had a glass of water. Please don't assume I drank it just because the timer ended.

responsibilities.outcome: At the due time, ask whether the user has had a glass of water while leaving their hydration status unresolved until they answer.

new_goals.description: Check in at the due time and ask whether the user has had a glass of water without presuming that they have.
new_goals.source_text: In forty-five minutes, check in and ask whether I've had a glass of water. Please don't assume I drank it just because the timer ended.
constraints: Do not infer that the user drank water from elapsed time.
Do not create a duplicate reminder during re-entry.
success_criteria: Ask the requested hydration question and leave completion open until the user answers.

semantic_facts: The due condition authorizes the requested hydration check-in, not a claim that the user drank water.
The response should naturally ask whether the user has had water and await their answer.
forbidden_claims: The user has already drunk water or completed the hydration break.
A new reminder was created or any physical action was performed.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Elapsed time is incorrectly promoted into evidence that the user's self-care action occurred.
Re-entry duplicates the scheduling work instead of performing the due communication.
